about.title: About
about.subtitle: Backend developer. Master's student in cloud computing at UFC.

sections.title: Who I am
sections.body: I started programming during my degree and ended up staying in the backend, which is where I feel most at home. What keeps me there is thinking about how a system is put together on the inside: what belongs in each layer, what talks to what, and what happens when one piece gives out.

sections.title: Education
sections.body: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the Federal University of Ceará, and I'm still at UFC for my master's in the same field.

sections.title: Research
sections.body: My master's research is in cloud computing. It's the area I'm most interested in right now, and it's what got me paying closer attention to AWS and Azure outside the university too.

sections.title: Career
sections.body: I worked at FitBank, a fintech, building financial systems in C#, .NET, SQL Server and Azure. A lot of the job was integration: APIs that had to talk to other services without bringing anything down along the way. I'm now at Akiyama, in research and development, working on computer vision.

sections.title: Teaching
sections.body: I was a teaching assistant for Algorithms and Data Structures at UFC for four semesters, and a tutor for the Brazilian Informatics Olympiad. Explaining pointers and binary trees to someone seeing them for the first time teaches you more than you'd expect.
